corePassives.description:
Toshiro charges up when releasing his basic attacks, Ice Dragon Lunge and Daiguren - Flock of Ice Pillars, his Technique, Daiguren - Hyoryu Senbi, and his Counterattack, Ryuusenka. Charging to a certain level generates 1 Ice Blossom, up to a maximum of 8. The number of Ice Blossoms is displayed in cross-shaped ice crystals to the left of HP. 
 When Toshiro releases his Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso, all Ice Blossoms are consumed to deal 6% additional DMG for each one consumed.
corePassives.name: Ice Blossom

corePassives.description:
When releasing a basic attack while moving in Bankai state, Toshiro gains 1 stack of Build Up, up to 5 stacks. 
 When Toshiro releases his Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso, all stacks of Build Up are consumed to deal 5% additional Spirit DMG for each stack consumed. If 5 stacks of Build Up are consumed, Toshiro's Spiritual Pressure is instantly filled to maximum at the end of Bankai state.
corePassives.name: Build Up

corePassives.description: When Toshiro enters Bankai State, each Ice Blossom grants 6% Ultimate Energy. if Toshiro releases Ultimate, Hyoten Hyakkaso, within 20 seconds, raises the Ultimate's damage by 80%.
corePassives.name: All Water is My Weapon

corePassives.description: For each 1% Critical Rate Toshiro has, his basic attack, Ice Dragon Lunge, deals 3% more damage, up to 180%.
corePassives.name: The Sky is at My Disposal

rotations.name: Frost Burst
rotations.notes: Toshiro wants to accumulate 5 stacks of Build Up before using Ultimate in Bankai state (obtained by using basic attacks while moving)

skills.description:
Toshiro wields Hyorinmaru to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 215%~537.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. ~~Ice Dragon Lunge~~ Tenso Jyurin 
 Toshiro condenses water vapor into an ice dragon which hits 5 times, dealing total DMG equal to 568%~1420% of ATK. Each hit landed charges Ice Blossom by the number of successful hits. 
 Dodging or countering does not reset the attack streak. If the attack is Interrupted, Tenso Jyurin will be prematurely removed. ~~Daiguren - Flock of Ice Pillars~~ Bankai State 
 Toshiro condenses long-ranged ice spikes which hit up to 5 times, dealing total DMG equal to 755% of ATK. Each hit adds a stack of Ice Edge. Each hit landed charges Ice Blossom by the number of successful hits. 
 Toshiro can perform basic attacks while moving.
skills.name: Frost unto the heavens, Hyorinmaru

skills.description:
Toshiro instantly creates massive ice crystals and fires them forward, dealing damage equal to 105%~262.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. Enemies hit by the technique are inflicted with 5 Freeze Points. After releasing the technique, creates an area filled with ice pillars ahead. The ice pillars explode in 2.5 seconds, dealing damage equal to 67%~167.5% of ATK to the enemies in the area, inflicting 5 Freeze Points on them, and granting Spiritual Pressure to Toshiro. ~~Ice Dragon Dive~~ Requires max Spiritual Pressure 
 Toshiro leaps into the air, leading an ice dragon to dive and slam into the enemy in front. This deals DMG equal to 577.5% of ATK and inflicts 10 Freeze Points. Toshiro then enters Tenso Jyurin, during which his basic attacks are replaced by Ice Dragon Lunge. This lasts for 2 sets of Ice Dragon Lunge or 10 seconds. ~~Daiguren - Hyoryu Senbi~~ In Bankai state with 5 stacks of Ice Edge 
 Toshiro flaps his ice wings and dives toward the enemy, launching a Freeze-up slash that deals damage equal to 642.5% of ATK and inflicting 10 Freeze Points on the enemy. While releasing the technique, Toshiro enters the Invincibility state, and you can tap the counterattack button to release Ryusenka.
skills.name: Ice Wall

skills.description:
Toshiro covers his body with ice and enters Bankai state. In this state, Toshiro can fly above the ground and all his moves will be replaced by more powerful ones. ~~Hyoten Hyakkaso~~ In Bankai state with max Ultimate Energy 
 Toshiro channels freezing air currents, causing myraids ice flowers to bloom on the enemy's body. This deals DMG equal to 2760% of ATK and consumes all Ice Blossoms. Each Ice Blossom consumed grants an extra 6% DMG multiplier. Releashing this skill removes Bankai State.
skills.name: Bankai - Daiguren Hyorinmaru

skills.description:
Toshiro falls back to create distance and then lunges at the enemy to counterattack, dealing damage equal to 1250% of ATK, inflicting 15 Freeze Points on them, and gaining Spiritual Pressure. ~~Ryusenka~~ Bankai State 
 Toshiro thrusts forward and evenlopes the enemy in a huge ice cross, dealing damage equal to 1500% of ATK and inflicting 15 Freeze Points while applying 2 stacks of Ice Edge on himself. Counterattack DMG dealt by actively tapping the counter button is reduced to 25%.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Toshiro gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step

ascend1: Increases the cap of Ice Blossoms to 12, with each Ice Blossom increasing the DMG and Crit DMG of the Ultimate Hyoten Hyakkaso by 2% and 5%. Releasing Hyoten Hyakkaso with 12 Ice Blossoms grants an extra damage bonus by 20% of Ultimate Mastery
Basic attacks deal 20% more DMG to targets affected by Freeze Points, and hitting targets charges Ice Blossom
ascend5: Ice Blossom cap to 12; each +6% DMG and +15% Crit DMG. At 12: extra bonus = 50% of Ultimate Mastery
Basic attacks deal 80% more DMG to frozen targets, and hitting targets charges Ice Blossom

ascend1: During Tenso Jyurin, basic attack damage is increased by 50%, damage taken is reduced by 25% while using basic attacks, and they cannot be interrupted
ascend5: During Tenso Jyurin, basic attack damage is increased by 100%, damage taken is reduced by 50% while using basic attacks, and they cannot be interrupted
